- Using `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300, s-maxage=60` on S3 uploads to bypass CloudFront invalidation permission gap — edge nodes auto-refresh within 60 seconds

- `parseReelTitle` splits video titles on em-dash (`—`) to extract property name and location (e.g. "Casa Rosario — Pembroke Pines, FL")
- `buildInvestmentOptions` returns option circles ordered by deal_type: jv→[Tokenized, JV Deal, Buyer], development→[JV Deal, Tokenized, Buyer], default→[Tokenized, JV Deal, Buyer]
